result.summary: Found 1 major visual issue: the bottom navigation is broken by overlap with a thick system gesture bar and clipping at the screen edge.

issues.description: Bottom navigation bar is obscured and clipped: a thick black horizontal bar overlaps the middle navigation icons and all bottom icons are cut off at the screen edge, leaving them partially hidden.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom safe-area inset padding and position the app tab bar above the system gesture area so icons are fully visible and tappable
